allowedWork: Extend generic Theseus plan phases and run slices with backward-compatible roadmap metadata and explicit linkage.
Keep KP plan revision v6 as the sole active roadmap authority while recording the approved lesson-first priority change against it.
Project the authoritative roadmap into a simple sortable Workbench table and stabilize Workbench search, review typing, and exact radical rewind.

Define lesson-first canonical presentation lineage for every lesson and card duplicate; preserve old identities as aliases or fixtures; project canonical choreography into cards, picker, Workbench, review aggregation, and promotion state.
disallowedWork: Do not create a second roadmap, presentation, review, or lifecycle state store; parse Markdown as the operational database; or fabricate animation representations.
Do not implement arithmetic, logarithm, trigonometry, geometry, probability, data, cross-domain, or quadratic animations in this contract.

Do not destructively delete generated fixtures until reference closure proves them unused; preserve old routes, review history, semantic identity, player clocks, exact seek and rewind, accessibility, and native KaTeX settlement.
Do not redesign Agenda, replace review persistence, rewrite graph history, add dynamic loading, or generalize visual recipes beyond the approved lesson-first ownership policy.
goal: Establish one authoritative complete product roadmap, project it into a simple sortable Workbench table, eliminate Workbench and review rebuild flicker, fix exact power-to-radical rewind settlement, and resume quadratic work through its visual checkpoint.
commitCadence: Commit every independently reversible verified slice in its owning repository with exact path staging and durable Theseus evidence.
stopConditions: H1 AUTHORITY: stop on multiple active approved KP plans, duplicated roadmap or execution ownership, silent linkage conflict, or a need for a second dashboard state store.
H2 COMPATIBILITY: stop before rewriting existing graph or event history or breaking v1 plan-revision or run-contract data.
H3 PRESERVATION: stop on animation identity, representation, route, player clock, review-history, accessibility, or exact seek and rewind regression.
H4 USER-OVERLAP: stop if required work cannot be separated from unrelated user-authored roadmap, thread, or exploratory design changes.
H5 WORKBENCH-RADICAL-REVIEW: stop after s27 until the user approves the sortable Workbench and exact radical rewind exemplar.
H6 QUADRATIC-REVIEW: stop after s30 until the user approves the quadratic branch choreography before publication or generalization.
H7 SCOPE: stop before deferred domain implementation, Agenda redesign, review-protocol replacement, dynamic loading, quadratic publication, or unsupported global generalization.
